messages:
Vik: Quick intake: new SI partner (ClearPath Integrations) wants a condensed onboarding + certification sprint. They specifically asked for a single-day "accelerator" workshop that covers marketplace listing, hardware SKU mapping, badge issuance, and a timed certification lab. Can Partnerships, Eng, Ops, and Marketing run a planning call tomorrow 08:00 PT?
Anya: I can do 08:00. We should scope the day: morning = lab + cert, afternoon = marketplace ingestion + badge + press/artifacts. Also define success gates (pass criteria) so partners know go/no-go.
Luis: Ill bring the lab harness and the CI scripts for the badge flip. Ops: can you confirm we have a partner-only preview mode for tiles? Last sprint we toggled via a flag and it worked well.
ops-bot: Flag available: `si_tile_visibility` values: partners_only | public. API: POST /flags/si_tile_visibility -d '{"value":"public"}'. Default: partners_only.
Megan: Marketing needs the partner quote and 4 screenshots by 07:15 PT for the asset pack. Also recommend a short partner-facing FAQ about the certification levels (bronze/silver/gold).
Vik: Good call. For the certification exam: propose a 45-minute practical with a checklist (deploy sample app, validate latency p50 < 250ms, run 5 integration smoke-tests, register SKU mapping correctly). Passing score >= 80%. Fail => remediation lab + retake in 3 days.
Anya: Id like telemetry gates too: after cert, partner should meet 99.9% successful inference calls over 24h or we downgrade badge to provisional. Add to the handbook.
Luis: SKUs for the initial tile (example): CP-EDGE-S, CP-GPU-8, CP-ACC-M. Demo env: accel-onboard-staging-2026.
Megan: Embargo note: partner wants internal preview only; public release target 18:00 UTC next Thursday. All copy shared under NDA until publish.
Vik: Ops, can you script a mock ingestion failure and the rollback path for the rehearsal so the partner sees the recovery flow and comms? We need a partner-facing template to use if things go wrong.
ops-bot: Suggested rollback flow: 1) flip `si_tile_visibility` -> partners_only, 2) purge CDN path /marketplace/tiles/clearpath, 3) post status to partner channel and schedule retry. Example commands: 
```bash
# set public
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI" https://deploy.internal/flags/si_tile_visibility -d '{"value":"public"}'
# purge CDN
curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -d '{"paths":["/marketplace/tiles/clearpath"]}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/flags/si_tile_visibility -d '{"value":"partners_only"}'
```
partner-pm: Wed appreciate a short comms script for customers: one-line incident notice + ETA. Helps our ops team practice.
Vik: Draft comms template: "We encountered an ingestion issue with your marketplace tile. We've reverted the listing to partner preview and are working on a fix. ETA: 30-60m. We'll update you at T+15m." Keep it simple.
Anya: For the accelerator agenda: 08:00 planning sync, 08:15 lab provisioning + creds, 09:00 timed cert lab (45m), 09:50 grading + remediation plan, 11:00 marketplace ingestion rehearsal (staging), 11:20 flag flip dry-run, 11:25 simulate failure & rollback, 11:40 retrospective + next steps.
Luis: Ill attach a small test harness to the calendar and a grading script. It will output pass/fail and a short log for the partner.
Megan: Ill prepare the Bronze/Silver/Gold badge criteria one-pager and the social asset checklist. Will share under NDA in the invite.
Vik: Final ask: keep channel chatter minimal during the rehearsal to simulate a real launch. Drop the rehearsal deck in the calendar and paste a one-pager here before EOD.
partner-pm: Thanks, this looks great. Well confirm attendee list and whether they want a shipped lab kit (option) or cloud credits. Prefer cloud credits for speed.
Anya: Noted. Action items: Luis  attach harness + SKUs; Megan  badge criteria + assets; Ops  flip script + rollback; Vik  cert rubric and grading script. Meeting invite created.
Vik: See you all 08:00 PT sharp. Bring logs/screenshots.
Megan: \ud83d\udc4d
Luis: \ud83d\udc4d
